item.title: Attorney General Ellison files opposition to latest X.AI attempt to block Minnesota’s anti-nudification law
item.description:
Publication Date: August 18, 2026

Court to hold hearing Wednesday on X.AI’s motion for a preliminary injunction against enforcing the law, after previously denying its motion for a temporary restraining order
